# HatchResume

> HatchResume (https://hatchresume.com) is a free online resume builder. It offers 25+ professional, ATS-friendly resume templates, a job-description keyword matcher, and one-click PDF export. There is no account, no watermark, and no paid tier: the app runs entirely in the visitor's browser and never uploads resume data to a server.

## Key facts

- Name: HatchResume (also written "Hatch Resume"); website https://hatchresume.com
- Price: free, with no trial, subscription, or paid export
- Sign-up: not required — there are no user accounts
- Privacy: resume data is stored only in the visitor's browser (local storage); HatchResume has no backend and receives no resume content
- Templates: 25+ designs across ATS-Optimized, Professional and Creative categories
- Output: A4 print-resolution PDF generated client-side, single or multi-page

## Pages

- [Home — free resume builder](https://hatchresume.com/): overview and the entry point to the editor
- [Resume templates](https://hatchresume.com/templates/): the full 25-template gallery
- [About](https://hatchresume.com/about/): HatchResume is a free online resume builder with 25+ ATS-friendly templates. No sign-up, no watermark, no subscription — and your resume never leaves your browser.
- [FAQ](https://hatchresume.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about HatchResume: pricing, sign-up, data privacy, ATS compatibility, PDF downloads, and mobile support.
- [Alternatives](https://hatchresume.com/alternatives/): Looking for a free alternative to Zety, Resume.io, Novoresume, Enhancv, Kickresume, Resume Genius or Canva? HatchResume builds ATS-friendly resumes and exports PDFs free, with no sign-up and no watermark.

## Templates

- Professional Executive (Professional): A classic, clean single-column layout optimized for corporate and executive jobs. Recommended for traditional industries.
- Modern Creative (Creative): A split-column layout designed to maximize space and readability. Best suited for tech, design, and marketing roles.
- Executive Centered (Professional): A pristine, center-aligned corporate structure with full-width section borders. Highly professional.
- Bold Tech Header (Creative): Featuring a high-contrast dark indigo top header band and tech-oriented grid layouts. Best for engineering and developers.
- Modern Professional (Professional): A sleek two-column header with heavy section borders in a strict black-and-white aesthetic.
- FAANG Engineer (ATS-Optimized): The single-column engineering standard used for Google, Meta and Amazon applications. Dense, scannable, and 100% ATS-parseable with full URLs in plain text.
- ATS Pro Plain (ATS-Optimized): Maximum parser compatibility: no lines, no columns, no graphics. Bold uppercase headers and plain text designed to pass every applicant tracking system.
- Harvard Classic (ATS-Optimized): The timeless Harvard-style format trusted by consulting, finance, and MBA applicants. Centered small-caps name with full-width ruled section headers.
- Compact One-Page (ATS-Optimized): A dense, space-efficient layout that fits senior careers on a single page. Navy accents and compact skill pills keep it modern yet parseable.
- Modern Accent (Professional): A contemporary single-column design with indigo accent bars on section headers. ATS-safe structure with just enough color to stand out.
- Executive Slate (Professional): A stately gray header band with wide-tracked section headings. Designed for directors, VPs, and senior management applications at top MNCs.
- Elegant Minimal (Creative): Light, airy typography with hairline rules and wide letter-spacing. A refined minimal look that stays fully single-column and parser-friendly.
- Right Rail Modern (Professional): The balanced two-column standard used by leading resume builders: experience on the left, a light-gray rail on the right for contact, skills, and education.
- Timeline Professional (Professional): Your career path drawn as a vertical timeline with connected milestones. A favorite modern style for showing steady progression.
- Classic Serif (ATS-Optimized): The timeless Times-style resume trusted for decades in law, government, and academia. Understated serif typography, fully single-column and ATS-safe.
- Corporate Blue (Professional): A solid blue header band over a clean single-column body — the most widely used corporate style at banks, consultancies, and Fortune 500 companies.
- Monogram Modern (Creative): A personal-brand favorite: your initials in a badge beside your name, followed by a clean modern layout.
- Teal Graduate (Creative): A fresh, approachable layout with teal accents — the go-to standard for students, internships, and first jobs.
- Swiss Minimal (Creative): Design-led Swiss typography: an oversized name, generous whitespace, and a single red rule. Popular for design, media, and marketing portfolios.
- Boxed Headers Classic (ATS-Optimized): The classic office-document style with shaded section header bars — instantly familiar to recruiters and cleanly parsed by tracking systems.
- Deedy Two-Column (Professional): The famous Deedy format loved by CS students and new grads: a narrow left column for education, skills, and links beside a wide experience column — all on clean white.
- Spearmint Fresh (ATS-Optimized): Modeled on the ever-popular Spearmint document style: crisp green rules over a plain single-column body. Familiar, friendly, and fully parseable.
- Coral Warm (Creative): A warm, approachable single-column layout with coral headings — a widely used standard for customer-facing, HR, and communications roles.
- Developer Mono (Creative): A monospace, terminal-inspired resume for developers — section headers with prompt markers and code-style typography, still strictly single-column.
- Oxford Side-Headings (Professional): The academic CV standard with section headings set in a left gutter beside the content — the layout used by Oxford-style and moderncv LaTeX resumes.
